entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello Sarah. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I need to set up a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please help me understand the reason? Is it a technical fault or more a matter of preference?
It's a fault. The pulse reading is wildly inaccurate. To be honest, the data it provides is complete garbage.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'd be happy to transfer you to our technical support team; they can run some remote diagnostics and often fix these kinds of issues in just a few minutes.
I appreciate that, but I really don't have time for a long troubleshooting call. I've already lost confidence in this specific device. At this point, I just want money back.
I understand your position completely. Typically, for a defect claim, we do need to verify the issue with our tech team before we can authorize a return for a full refund.

I see. Listen, I'm a VIP member and have been for a few years. This is the first product that hasn't met my expectations. Can we perhaps find a more direct solution? I'm not trying to be difficult, I'd just prefer to send this one back.
Of course, let me take a look at your account and our policies. Thank you for your loyalty to VeloFit, we certainly value it. Please hold one moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I see you received the band 18 days ago. Looking at our policy here, items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely go ahead and process this return for you.
That's fantastic. Thank you, Sarah. I appreciate you making that simple for me.

It's my pleasure. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. And for the inconvenience, I've also added a 15% discount code to your account for your next purchase. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's all. You've been very helpful.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
